name: Wiz Email App
summary: Shopify email app that drafts abandoned cart, welcome, browse and winback flows with AI, plus popups, campaigns, segmentation and analytics.
best_for: small Shopify stores that want AI-drafted welcome, abandoned cart and winback emails with a free start
skip_if: you need proven deliverability data or a large contact list, since we did not test sending
honest_knock: We sent no email, so we cannot confirm delivery. The listing says the Pro and AI Agency prices rise as active contacts grow and does not give the steps. Sending is limited on a development store, and the app asks for broad store data at install.

sessions.what: Our AI assistant ran the test on 21 November 2026 on a Shopify development store, with the interface in English. We installed Wiz, filled in the brand settings, let the AI draft email flows and opened the welcome email preview. We sent no email.
findings: Install: the permission screen lists customer data, staff data and store data (customers, products, orders, discounts, analytics, online store).
Flows: about five minutes after install the AI had drafted five flows with 14 emails and a popup from our store branding: welcome 3, abandoned checkout 3, browse 2, post-purchase 3 and winback 3.
Preview: the flows start disabled, and the welcome email preview used our store name and products.
Plan: on a development store the app showed a free plan, with sending limited.
not_tested: sending a real email and how it lands in inboxes
paid plans and how the price grows with contacts
sessions.note: Findings as written up after the session; no pass/fail per task was scored.
